title.narrative: Fostering food security to prevent conflict and ensure stability in the Central Rift Valley of Eth.

description.narrative: Conflicts and food insecurity are pervasive and intertwined in numerous parts of Ethiopia. Vulnerable smallholder farmers' food insecurity is exacerbated by the risks of climate change, which results in internal displacement and an economic crisis of subsistence. This project strives to showcase how to systematically address the problem of food insecurity, conflict and build climate resilience of rural community members in the Central rift valley areas in Ethiopia.The project will specifically target vulnerable rural women farmers, conflict-affected community members, and unemployed youth by fostering the adoption of climate-resilient innovations and conflict resolution approaches.
To enhance food security as a way to prevent conflict and instability among the vulnerable rural communities of the Central rift valley areas in Ethiopia.
